_comment: Copy this file to api_keys.json (same folder) and fill in what you use. api_keys.json itself is gitignored and never gets committed — everything below stays local to your machine.
_comment_gemini: Primary voice + reasoning engine. Optional — everything except live voice works without it.
_comment_fallback: Used automatically if Gemini fails or its quota is exhausted, for text-based tools (code_helper, dev_agent, self_maintain, search summaries, FTA's extraction step, etc). Tried in this order: Claude, then Groq, then a custom/local endpoint — configure any/all. The custom slot is the right place to wire in any OpenAI-compatible API that isn't one of the named providers (e.g. OpenRouter, xkiro, a private LLM gateway, LM Studio, Ollama).
_comment_custom_fallback: fallback_api_url is the base URL of any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint — the code appends '/v1/chat/completions' to it. So for a host like https://api.example.com, set fallback_api_url=https://api.example.com (no trailing slash, no /v1). The slot uses Bearer-token auth; set fallback_api_key to the API key the provider gave you, and fallback_model to the model id. Leave all three blank to skip this slot.
_comment_code_agent: Code-writing tasks are delegated to the local Cline CLI (the Cline VS Code extension's headless mode). On Windows, cline.cmd lets LITE launch it without a PowerShell session. Override cline_command only if your installed Cline version expects different flags; the default below matches Cline 3.x (prompt is a positional argument, --auto-approve takes a boolean). Set cline_api_key / cline_base_url (or the CLINE_API_KEY / CLINE_BASE_URL env vars) to point Cline at a non-default provider — the empty defaults work only if Cline itself has a working provider configured via `cline auth`.
_comment_gas: Connects the affiliate_growth_agent tool to GAS (Growth Agent Service) — the always-on Cloudflare Worker that keeps drafting content and tracking PartnerStack/Exness even while LITE isn't running. Get gas_worker_url from `wrangler deploy`'s output; gas_worker_key is the WORKER_SHARED_SECRET you set via `wrangler secret put`. Leave blank to disable assign_job/get_report (the rest of affiliate_growth_agent still works without it).
_comment_search: Powers web search / news summaries. DuckDuckGo is always used as the no-key baseline regardless of this setting.
_comment_github: Only needed for self_update's clone mode against a private repo when no interactive git credential prompt is available.
_comment_hotkey: System-wide mute toggle (works even when LITE's window isn't focused). pynput format — see https://pynput.readthedocs.io/en/latest/keyboard.html#global-hotkeys
